## Description

Ops console (separate app/role, no PHI in the control plane): tenant list per country with plan, status, flags; onboarding automation (create tenant, seed config, invite owner); support access requests that the clinic approves, time-boxed (e.g. 2 h), scoped, fully audited and visible to the clinic in its access log.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Support staff cannot see tenant data without an approved, time-limited grant; access ends automatically.
- [ ] **AC2.** Every support action is audited and listed in the clinic's access log (F-12).
- [ ] **AC3.** Flags can be toggled per tenant from the console with audit.
- [ ] **AC4.** The control plane stores no PHI (data map updated).

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
